Execution rule: Preserve old checked approval record as historical; create a fresh current-correction approval record with revised-content approval initially unchecked.
Separate historical v1.0.0 checks from current correction status; align current figure-check count/definitions and prevent old author approval from appearing current.
External reviewer checks normalization denominator, calibration arithmetic, fail-closed gate, outcome protection, non-nested CV caveat and supersession logic.
Record concrete reviewer findings and disposition; do not treat generic approval as reproducibility evidence.
Replace `selected regularization and confidence thresholds` with wording that candidate thresholds were evaluated under frozen eligibility criteria.
One sentence: corrected source-label-agnostic mapping failed B_ASC calibration and no corrected disease outcome was estimated.
If useful after external review, rerender S10 panel d from frozen calibration candidates as coverage-vs-state-precision frontier; no disease outcomes or retuning.
Both authors approve the corrected manuscript, supplement, figures, attachments, cover, correction disclosure and journal choice.
Prioritize fit; evaluate npj Systems Biology and Applications / Communications Biology / Genome Medicine; institution verifies current Q1/JCR/CAS.
After journal selection, rerun figures from code to the journal's exact requested width/format; no manual figure edits.
Keep v1.0.0 immutable; tag exact final corrected commit as a new version such as v1.1.0.
Publish a matching version-specific DOI, then update Data Availability/citation/portal metadata.
Rebuild documents and deterministic package after author approval, journal formatting and DOI insertion.
Only upload files authorized by the new package; preserve receipt, manuscript number and actual uploaded-file hashes.
No threshold relaxation, elastic-net replacement, seed/grid expansion, new mapper/cohort/TF/gene set before first submission unless external review identifies a decision-changing defect.
